objects: the one observed project directory -> 0o2750 (setgid kept so later entries still inherit the group)
P1a.ownership_rule: st_uid == os.geteuid(), not a hard-coded 65532: an identity may only reopen its OWN objects, and main's existing worker-identity check separately pins that the worker is uid 65532
P1a.turn_two: publishes nothing; the manager-owned 0o660 restored working copy accepted at R1/178875 is untouched
P1a.verification: type, owner and group checked through THE SAME O_NOFOLLOW descriptor that is then fchmodded, so a symlink refuses rather than redirecting and nothing can be swapped between check and change

P1b.content_field: read / excluded / unreadable:<errno>, because a deliberate exclusion and an access failure both leave sha256 null
refused: a failed per-entry stat -> state-coverage-incomplete (the shape the operator observed: a 0o600 directory is READABLE so scandir succeeds and each child's stat fails)
an unreadable SELECTED session -> selected-session-unreadable at subset, not a later digest mismatch
P1b.rule: unreadable CONTENT is tolerated; unreadable STRUCTURE never is
P1b.tolerated: an unreadable regular file, recorded content: unreadable:<errno>, sha256 None, run continues
P1b.why: all three absence claims -- unexpected-credential-entry home-wide, project-key-ambiguous, foreign-session-state -- are read from NAMES, and a name is visible in the parent listing

P1c.boundary: valid_failure_detail refuses a malformed triple, and a refusal carrying an errno

focused_run.execution: offline fake-engine tests and bounded local Python pipe fixtures only; no actual engine/model/credential

not_done: chmod or chown of either consumed tree

regression_tests_for_the_returned_defect.D1: test_an_unenterable_directory_refuses_rather_than_reporting_absence -- the hidden directory CONTAINS a foreign .jsonl and a credential-shaped entry, so tolerating it would report those absence checks as passed
regression_tests_for_the_returned_defect.D2: test_turn_two_publishes_nothing_and_the_restored_copy_stands -- a manager-owned 0o660 restored file is still 0o660

stated_limitation: if the blocking directory is not the project directory the run REFUSES rather than passes -- at state-coverage-incomplete with a named step and errno instead of unclassified. Covered by test_a_blocked_directory_names_its_step_and_errno.
test_note: The synthetic trees use mode 0o000 rather than 0o700/0o600 to stand in for the observed state, because this process owns its fixtures and only a zeroed owner triad denies it. The FakeEngine creates state at 0o700/0o600 and applies P1a, so the controller path exercises the real sequence.
